objs.name: document
objs.description: Document in P&R Management system representing a policy, guideline, procedural instruction, or work instruction.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person who interacts with the system and can be assigned roles such as reader, author, reviewer, releaser, translator.

objs.name: usergroup
objs.description: Group of Users with defined roles used for authorizations and distribution.

objs.name: distributionlist
objs.description: List of Users or UserGroups automatically informed about document release and acknowledgement.

objs.name: informationobject
objs.description: Attachment content that can be added to a Document.

objs.name: additionalinformation
objs.description: Attachment type that is not subject to the release cycle.

objs.name: equipment
objs.description: Attachment type released with the main document and capable of affecting the main document version.

objs.name: changeproposal
objs.description: Proposal to change or amend a Document; belongs to a Document.

evts.name: attach_information_object_to_document
evts.description: Attach a new InformationObject (AdditionalInformation or Equipment) to a Document.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Document is automatically converted to PDF after saving.

evts.name: create_document_version
evts.description: A new version of a Document is created when content or attributes change or attachments are updated.

evts.name: start_release_process
evts.description: Begin the 3-step release process: Creator, Review, Release.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Document is released after the release workflow; signatures are collected.

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: All workflow participants sign electronically; signatures are documented.

evts.name: assign_authorizations
evts.description: Authorizations and release participants are assigned.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Employees with author rights can create Change Proposals for a Document.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released content can be translated into another language and must be checked and released.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Check and extend document validity; may trigger a validity extension workflow.

evts.name: override_document
evts.description: Override process to invalidate and archive a document and its attachments.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Reactivate an invalidated document; creates a new version and restores metadata.

evts.name: distribute_document_by_email
evts.description: Distribute document by e-mail to assigned distribution lists.

evts.name: acknowledge_distribution
evts.description: Recipients are prompted to acknowledge distribution; acknowledgements are tracked.

o2o.description: Document is created or modified by a User (performer).
Document is distributed to a DistributionList.
Document distribution can involve a UserGroup.
InformationObject is attached to a Document.
Change Proposals belong to a Document.
